title: Card Payment Instrument
description: A basic card payment instrument with visible card details. Can be inherited by a handler's instrument schema to define handler-specific display details or more complex credential structures.

available_card_payment_instrument.title: Available Card Payment Instrument
available_card_payment_instrument.description: Declares card instrument availability with constraints. The `constraints` object follows the universal constraint shape (`constraint.json`): a `required_fields` list naming top-level instrument properties that MUST be present (e.g., `billing_address`), plus card-specific custom keys (`brands`, `billing_address`, `credentials`, `funding_sources`). The credentials and funding-source axes share `credential_constraint.json` as their item primitive; funding-source entries MUST name credential types whose schema inherits from `payment_funding_source.json`.

brands.description: Accepted card brands (e.g., ['visa', 'mastercard']). Card brand is a property of the underlying card surfaced via `display.brand`, not a credential field, so it sits at the instrument-constraint level.

billing_address.description: Constraint on the instrument's `billing_address` field. The address itself is required only when `billing_address` appears in this object's `required_fields`.

credentials.description: Credential wire shapes the handler accepts. Constraints here describe the wire credential as transmitted.

funding_sources.description: Underlying funding sources the handler accepts. Entries MUST reference credential types inheriting from `payment_funding_source.json`. Constraints here describe the underlying instrument regardless of which wire credential conveys it; they are NOT duplicated under `credentials`.

type.description: Indicates this is a card payment instrument.

display.description: Display information for this card payment instrument.

brand.description: The card brand/network (e.g., visa, mastercard, amex).

last_digits.description: Last 4 digits of the card number.

expiry_month.description: The month of the card's expiration date (1-12).

expiry_year.description: The year of the card's expiration date.

description.description: An optional rich text description of the card to display to the user.

card_art.description: An optional URI to a rich image representing the card.
